Text: Q: What is considered a high dose of prednisone? A: The starting dose of prednisone may be between 5 mg to 60 mg per day. A dose above 40 mg per day may be considered a high dose. However, everybody responds differently to prednisone, so what might be a high dose depends on the person and the condition.
Q: Can you take prednisone with Keytruda? A: Use prednisone with Keytruda or Keytruda Qlex only if your healthcare provider prescribes it. Prednisone is a corticosteroid that lowers immune system activity. It may reduce how well Keytruda works or increase your risk of infection. However, your doctor may prescribe prednisone to treat certain immune-related side effects caused by Keytruda.

B. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
